name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund
description: AIF is a medium-long term debt financing facility for investment in viable projects for post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets.
descriptionHindi: कटाई उपरांत फसल प्रबंधन और सामुदायिक कृषि अवसंरचना परियोजनाओं के लिए दीर्घकालिक वित्तीय सहायता और ब्याज अनुदान।
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefits: Interest subvention of 3% per annum on loans up to ₹2 crore for up to 7 years, along with credit guarantee coverage under CGTMSE.
benefitsHindi: ₹2 करोड़ तक के ऋण पर 7 वर्षों के लिए 3% प्रति वर्ष ब्याज अनुदान तथा क्रेडिट गारंटी कवरेज।
eligibilityText: Farmers, FPOs, PACS, Agri-entrepreneurs, and startups establishing post-harvest storage, cold chains, and processing units.
eligibilityTextHindi: किसान, एफपीओ, प्राथमिक कृषि सहकारी समितियां, कृषि उद्यमी और स्टार्टअप।
sourceName: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
